description: Opus BB unit B24: Utility Umbrella's `onEnd` runs `runEvent('WeatherChange')` on its old holder in sun or rain. In Pelipper's rain, Castform holds Utility Umbrella (so Forecast keeps the base forme); Weavile, holding nothing, Tricks it away: `takeItem` runs the umbrella's End with Castform's item gone, Forecast now sees the rain and Castform becomes Castform-Rainy. Weavile's new umbrella Start does nothing (Weavile does not ignore it).
